### 2026-10-25 – pcb worktime. struggled a bit with the custom footprints and adding extra lines + shapes to them. basically, you just have to rightclick on each pad and select edit as graphic shape, and then in footp

**4.43h**

pcb worktime. struggled a bit with the custom footprints and adding extra lines + shapes to them. basically, you just have to rightclick on each pad and select edit as graphic shape, and then in footprint editor, go to tools and cleanup graphics. then you save after each cleanup and then u repeat for all the other pads. there's prob a better way to do this but idk.
